objective: Resolve the governed context capsule DB health warning caused by status interpretation and authority-boundary labeling rather than failed DB validation.

problem_statement.observed_symptom: Context capsules recommended review_database_health because database_health.status was derived from whole current-state warning status.
problem_statement.actual_db_validation: outputs/audits/global_health_report.json reported db_validation.status success and db_health.status pass.
problem_statement.secondary_symptom: current_state_view labeled the authority boundary as mixed, causing targetless maintenance capsules to defer authority despite registry-primary semantic authority passing.

changes.action: Recognize global validation warning reports as warn instead of unknown.
Derive context-capsule database_health.status from db_validation rather than whole current-state advisory status.
Treat stateful_projection coverage as non-blocking current-state coverage.
Replace hardcoded mixed authority boundary with registry_primary_mixed_sources to distinguish registry-primary mixed-source projection from an authority conflict.

non_claim_boundary: This repair does not alter canonical registry authority.
This repair does not resolve historical patch-chain defer states.
This repair does not promote any theorem, bridge, or lexicon term.
